start.title: [TODO:ru] A Famine in the Land
start.text:
[TODO:ru] A severe famine strikes the land of Canaan.
What do you do?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Go down to Egypt to live there as a foreigner for a while
[TODO:ru] Sail across the sea to a distant island
[TODO:ru] Stay in Canaan and lead an army

road_south.title: [TODO:ru] As You Near Egypt
road_south.text:
[TODO:ru] You are about to enter Egypt.
What do you say to your wife Sarai?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'I know what a beautiful woman you are â the Egyptians will kill me to take you'
[TODO:ru] 'The Lord will protect us; we have nothing to fear'
[TODO:ru] Say nothing at all to Sarai

fear_rises.title: [TODO:ru] The Request
fear_rises.text:
[TODO:ru] You ask Sarai to do something to protect your life.
What is it?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well because of you'
[TODO:ru] 'Say you are my mother, so no one will notice'
[TODO:ru] 'Say we are strangers who have never met'

the_lie.title: [TODO:ru] The Egyptians See Sarai
the_lie.text:
[TODO:ru] You arrive in Egypt.
How do the Egyptians respond to Sarai?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The Egyptians see that she is very beautiful
[TODO:ru] The Egyptians ignore her completely
[TODO:ru] The Egyptians drive her away from the city

entering_egypt.title: [TODO:ru] Pharaoh's Officials
entering_egypt.text:
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh's officials see Sarai.
What do they do?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] They praise her to Pharaoh, and she is taken into his palace
[TODO:ru] They chase Abram out of Egypt at once
[TODO:ru] They ignore her and offer no attention

officials_come.title: [TODO:ru] For Sarai's Sake
officials_come.text:
[TODO:ru] Because of Sarai, Pharaoh treats you well.
How does he treat Abram?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] He gives you sheep, cattle, donkeys, servants and camels
[TODO:ru] He puts Abram in prison
[TODO:ru] He gives Abram nothing at all

sarah_taken.title: [TODO:ru] The Lord Strikes
sarah_taken.text:
[TODO:ru] The Lord does not remain silent.
What does He do because of Sarai?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The Lord inflicts serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household
[TODO:ru] The Lord sends fire down on Egypt
[TODO:ru] The Lord remains silent

gifts_arrive.title: [TODO:ru] Pharaoh Summons You
gifts_arrive.text:
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh calls for you.
What does he say?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me she was your wife?'
[TODO:ru] 'Thank you for your gifts â please stay'
[TODO:ru] 'Sarai will remain in my house forever'

plagues.title: [TODO:ru] Take Her and Go
plagues.text:
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh gives his order.
What does he command?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 'Here is your wife. Take her and go!'
[TODO:ru] 'You must remain here as my servant forever'
[TODO:ru] 'I will keep Sarai and you may return to Canaan alone'

confronted.title: [TODO:ru] Escorted Out
confronted.text:
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh gives orders about you.
What happens?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Pharaoh's men send you on your way, with your wife and everything you have
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh's men strip you of all your possessions
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh's men put you in chains

expelled.text:
[TODO:ru] You leave Egypt.
Where do you go?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Go up from Egypt to the Negev, with your wife and all you have
[TODO:ru] Stay in Egypt and settle there for good
[TODO:ru] Go east across the desert to Assyria

altar.title: [TODO:ru] Back to the Altar
altar.text:
[TODO:ru] You return to the place between Bethel and Ai,
to the altar you had built at first, and there you call on the name of the Lord.
